title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://cdn.876553.xyz/Q1fc8a9OCb7AsC6f/dl/01b981d8-71fe-… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors detected an attacker URL used in the wild on 2026-11-09. The URL was observed twice and is associated with the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The attacker infrastructure was identified as being located in Hong Kong. This URL is linked to attacker payloads such as tool downloads, callbacks, or exploitation targets. Organizations are advised to block and monitor this URL and search their proxy, web, or WAF logs for any requests to it.
